Land Acquisition - Wewegedaragama, Uvaparanagama D/S/D, Badulla District  
Aththalapitiy, Bandarawela D/S/D, Badulla District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific parcels of land for a public purpose. It provides detailed land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and locations. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. The mention of the minister is incidental to the authorization of the land-related action and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would shift it to a government-related type.
